provenance: Academic research benchmark published at ASE24, WWW25, FSE26. Downloaded from official GitHub repository https://github.com/phamquiluan/RCAEval at release tag v1.7.0 (published 2026-09-03). Contains 9 datasets with 735 real failure cases from microservice deployments. Includes 15 reproducible baseline algorithms: metric-based, trace-based, and multi-source methods.
notes: Contains benchmark code + dataset links/scripts. Datasets include: N9, N27, rcaeval_v2 variants. 735 labeled real failure cases across 9 datasets. Data sourced from real microservice platforms (Online Boutique, Sock Shop, Train Ticket on Kubernetes). Multi-modal: metrics (Prometheus) + traces (Jaeger). License: MIT - permits research AND training use. Version 1.7.0 is the latest release as of download date.
